stories.title: Asesinada en México una estudiante española que estaba de intercambio en la Universidad de Morelos

en.title: Spanish student killed in Mexico while on exchange at University of Morelos
en.summary: A 21-year-old Spanish exchange student named Claudia Tacoronte, studying Early Childhood Education, was fatally attacked with a blade in Mexico. State authorities are investigating the incident as a femicide.

stories.title: Madrid levanta la suspensión del estadio del Rayo Vallecano y puede volver a funcionar

en.title: Madrid lifts suspension of Rayo Vallecano stadium and it can resume operations
en.summary: Madrid authorities have lifted the suspension of Rayo Vallecano's stadium following a new audit. The inspection confirmed that facilities are operational and suitable for normal functioning.

stories.title: La Comunidad de Madrid levanta la suspensión cautelar del estadio de Vallecas

en.title: Madrid Community lifts precautionary suspension of Vallecas stadium
en.summary: The Madrid regional government has lifted the precautionary suspension of Vallecas stadium after a second audit confirmed the facility is operational and in adequate condition. The team can return to play there soon.

stories.title: La Comunidad de Madrid levanta la orden de suspensión del estadio de Vallecas al Rayo

en.title: Madrid Community lifts suspension order of Vallecas stadium from Rayo
en.summary: The Madrid regional government has temporarily lifted the suspension order for Rayo's stadium facility, though it maintains plans to terminate the concession. The team will return to play at home against Athletic on October 10.

stories.title: La Comunidad de Madrid levanta la suspensión del Estadio de Vallecas: la auditoría concluye "una mejora material y documental muy significativa"

en.title: Madrid Community lifts suspension of Vallecas Stadium: audit concludes "very significant material and documentary improvement"
en.summary: The Madrid regional government has removed the suspension on Vallecas Stadium after an audit found substantial improvements. Rayo Vallecano will return to their home stadium on October 10 to play Athletic Bilbao.

stories.title: Un militar español destinado en la OTAN, suspendido por su relación con una mujer rusa a la que conoció en Tinder: "No se pudo probar nada"

en.title: Spanish military officer stationed at NATO suspended over relationship with Russian woman met on Tinder: "Nothing could be proven"
en.summary: A Spanish NATO-based officer was suspended following a relationship with a Russian-origin woman he met on a dating application. Authorities stated they could not establish any wrongdoing.

stories.title: La OTAN retira la acreditación a un militar español que mantenía una relación con una acusada de espionaje para Rusia

en.title: NATO withdraws accreditation from Spanish military officer who maintained relationship with woman accused of espionage for Russia
en.summary: NATO initiated an investigation and revoked accreditation for a Spanish officer stationed at Northwood base after he began a relationship with a woman of Russian origin accused of espionage. The woman, identified as having British and Polish dual nationality, denies the allegations.

stories.title: Expulsan a un militar español de una base de la OTAN por su relación con una supuesta espía rusa

en.title: Spanish military officer expelled from NATO base over relationship with alleged Russian spy
en.summary: A Spanish military officer was expelled from a NATO base following a relationship with a woman holding dual British and Polish nationality who he met through a dating application.

stories.title: Zapatero pide a la Audiencia que excluya del ‘caso Plus Ultra’ sus negocios en Bolivia y advierte de la “patente de corso” del juez en sus pesquisas

en.title: Zapatero asks Court to exclude his Bolivia business dealings from 'Plus Ultra case' and warns of judge's 'carte blanche' in investigations
en.summary: The former Spanish president's legal team seeks to exclude a UDEF report concerning his dealings on behalf of a Peruvian group with Bolivian authorities from the Plus Ultra case.

stories.title: Oasis anuncia una gira por Europa y Estados Unidos para 2027 con dos conciertos en Barcelona el 10 y 11 de julio

en.title: Oasis Announces European and US Tour for 2027 with Two Barcelona Concerts on July 10 and 11
en.summary: The Gallagher brothers' band Oasis has announced a 2027 world tour starting May 21 in Glasgow and ending September 19 in Knebworth, including two Barcelona dates in July.

stories.title: Zapatero pide a la Sala Penal de la Audiencia que frene "la patente de corso" del juez Calama y anule la investigación sobre sus negocios en Bolivia

en.title: Zapatero asks Criminal Court to halt judge Calama's 'unchecked authority' and annul investigation into his Bolivia business dealings
en.summary: The former government president contends that 200,000 euros he received for managing affairs with Bolivian authorities should be excluded from the Plus Ultra case.

stories.title: La relación por Tinder de un militar español con una mujer de origen ruso desata una investigación por espionaje en la OTAN

en.title: Spanish military officer's Tinder relationship with woman of Russian origin triggers NATO espionage investigation
en.summary: A commander stationed in Northwood was suspended and has returned to Spain following a dating app connection with a Russian woman that sparked counterintelligence concerns.

stories.title: Illa saca pecho de agenda económica y de "tener proyecto" en el arranque del curso

en.title: Illa boasts of economic agenda and 'having a project' at start of academic year
en.summary: The Catalan leader emphasizes pursuing the correct path by placing Catalonia in its rightful position and refrains from making excuses regarding the various crises his administration faces.

stories.title: Los líderes nacionalistas de Escocia, Gales e Irlanda del Norte se unen por la independencia

en.title: Nationalist leaders of Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland unite for independence
en.summary: Scotland's First Minister has proposed a referendum on independence for 2031, though this is viewed as unlikely by other UK leaders. Nationalist leaders from Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland have coordinated on independence objectives.

stories.title: La cartera anti-IA: plumas estilográficas, Warhammer y cámaras de vídeo

en.title: The anti-AI portfolio: fountain pens, Warhammer and video cameras
en.summary: Non-digital activities and products such as diaries, puzzles, and hobby books are experiencing renewed popularity. Consumers are increasingly turning to analog alternatives.

stories.title: Berenberg amplía el recorrido en Bolsa de Repsol hasta cerca del 30%

en.title: Berenberg extends Repsol's stock market upside to near 30%
en.summary: German investment firm Berenberg raised its price target for oil company Repsol to 37.50 euros, implying further gains of 28% from current levels. The firm upgraded its valuation and recommends buying the stock.

stories.title: Puig compra el 50% que no tenía de Isdin a Esteve por 1.200 millones

en.title: Puig acquires the 50% stake in Isdin from Esteve for 1.2 billion euros
en.summary: Luxury group Puig completed the acquisition of its remaining 50% stake in skincare company Isdin for 1.2 billion euros. The purchase helps reduce Puig's dependency on its fragrance business, which currently represents over 70% of total revenue.
